subject: Customer advocate availability & alternate testimonial offer
messages:
From: Amelia Ross <amelia@novaprod.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: SalesOps <procurement@novaprod.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reference request for upcoming RFP

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — we’re in the final stages of an RFP and the procurement team asked for two customer references who have run production inference workloads at scale. I know NovaProd leaned on Redwood last year for a pilot, and I wanted to check availability.

Specific asks from procurement:
- 20–30 minute call (screenshare ok) to confirm latency and throughput claims
- Short written blurb we can include in the RFP (1–2 sentences)
- Permission to list NovaProd as a customer on vendor materials

Timing: ideally next week (week of Nov 9) — we can be flexible on the time of day.

If your team is not able to do both references, would a single live call + a short anonymized quote work? Also open to an on-record recorded testimonial if that’s easier for your customer.

Thanks — if you can point me to who at Redwood we should coordinate with, I’ll loop procurement into a follow-up.

Best,
Amelia
Amelia Ross
Director, Strategic Procurement
NovaProd
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia@novaprod.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reference request for upcoming RFP

Hi Amelia — thanks for the note and congrats on the RFP progress. Appreciate the clear ask.

Quick status: NovaProd participated in a case study with us in Q2 (public page live), and they’ve already been referenced multiple times for sales cycles this year. We try to avoid over-requesting from the same advocates in short windows — we call it reference fatigue.

Options that should meet procurement needs without over-burdening your team or NovaProd:
1) Single live call (20 mins) with NovaProd’s engineering lead + a short anonymized quote we can share for the RFP.
2) If procurement needs a second "reference", we can provide a short on-record recorded testimonial from a different customer in the same vertical (anonymized if requested).
3) NovaProd can opt into a brief written blurb & a single call; in return we offer a small product credit for a future month (we can document in the mutual action plan).

I’ve attached a simple reference-matrix that shows recent advocate activity (helps procurement understand recency) and a one-page consent template your legal folks can sign quickly.

If that sounds OK, Marissa (cc’d) will coordinate logistics and Sergio from our CS team can serve as the alternate advocate if needed. Can you confirm which option procurement prefers and a couple slots next week (Nov 10–12)?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: consent-briefing-template.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reference request for upcoming RFP

Amelia — thanks for working with Kimberly. Quick logistics and a couple added details:

- I attached a reference availability matrix (novaprod-reference-matrix.xlsx) that highlights when NovaProd has been included in sales references or marketing collateral. You’ll see Q2 case study + two sales reference calls in July and September.
- To minimize fatigue we recommend one short call + a written blurb. If procurement needs a second direct contact, we can offer Sergio (CS) or an anonymized transcript from a vertical peer.
- If NovaProd signs the consent template, we’ll mark the exposure as: RFP-only (not marketing) or Marketing-OK per their preference — please indicate which in the signed form.

Sergio — if you’re able to be the substitute advocate for a secondary call, can you confirm availability next week? If not, we’ll source a vertical peer.

Amelia — attaching a redlined consent template and the availability matrix. We can also provide a one-paragraph sample blurb to save your team time.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Thanks — this is helpful and totally reasonable. Procurement prefers:
- Option 1: single live 20–25 minute call with NovaProd’s engineering lead (Nov 11, 11:00–11:30 PT works)
- Written blurb (we’ll accept an anonymized 1–2 sentence quote if that reduces exposure)
- Consent form: RFP-only (no marketing)

We’re happy to accept Sergio as the substitute for the second contact if we need follow-up; please let us know if he can join the live call or be on standby.

I’ve attached the procurement intake form they asked us to return (not included here). If you can send the sample blurb and a copy of the signed consent after Nov 11, that will close our RFP reference requirement.

Appreciate the flexible approach to avoid advocate fatigue — we’ll make the call efficient.

Best,
Amelia

NovaProd
